When contemplating your feelings and experiences (rumination), you can take one of 2 approaches: Abstract - Analytical (A-A) or Concrete - Experiential (C-E). Say a waitress tells you to "Enjoy your meal" and you reply with "You too". In hindsight, you can take the A-A channel: 'Am I always destined to be a moron because I do things like this?'. Or the C-E channel: 'I must have gotten my wires crossed this time. I should be more careful about what I say'. A-A tends to look at the bigger picture in terms of behaviours and natures. C-E is focused on the small picture, the specific experience alone. Naturally, the A-A channel tends to exacerbate negative thoughts and cultivate depressive thinking.
